Perfect! I can see the issue clearly. The notification-worker is trying to resolve `smtp-relay` (which is the hostname from when it was in the notify namespace), but that host no longer exists in the notify namespace because it was moved to the shared-infra namespace on Sunday.

The logs show:
```
ERROR job email-31877 failed: smtp dial: dial tcp: lookup smtp-relay on 10.96.0.10:53: no such host
```

This is a DNS resolution failure because `smtp-relay` no longer resolves within the notify namespace. When smtp-relay was moved to shared-infra, the notification-worker configuration needs to be updated to reference the service in the shared-infra namespace.

Let me search the Kubernetes documentation to confirm the proper way to reference services across namespaces.
